mapper.select: SELECT id, dict_type, dict_name, dict_code, dict_label, dict_value, sort, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag, remark FROM sys_dict WHERE dict_type = #{dictType} AND del_flag = 0 ORDER BY sort ASC
SELECT dict_type, dict_name, MIN(sort) as sort FROM sys_dict WHERE del_flag = 0 GROUP BY dict_type, dict_name ORDER BY sort ASC
